snippet.title: Cursed Mansion FULL Game Walkthrough / Playthrough - Let's Play (No Commentary)
snippet.description:
Cursed Mansion By Dragon Emperors Maid Route Ending Horror Adventure Game Part 1 to Ending [Microsoft Windows]

Cursed Mansion starts out in a deep forest. A mysterious storm drives Rose to seek shelter in a huge mansion which at first glance seems to be empty. As she enters, the door slams shut and traps her inside.

Cursed Mansion: https://store.steampowered.com/app/967120/Cursed_Mansion/
Developer: Dragon Emperors
Genres: Adventure, Indie, RPG
Platforms: Microsoft Windows
